snapshot.text: Mixed system with a national health insurance (SeNaSa) and expanding public hospital network. The Dominican health minister presided over the 79th World Health Assembly in 2026.

priorities.title: New hospitals
priorities.text: The president opened 30 hospitals to strengthen the public network.

priorities.title: Childhood cancer
priorities.text: The country won the international CureAll 2026 award for progress against childhood cancer.
